Due to an unresolved access dispute, no direct travel link exists between Office Alpha and Office Beta.
Furthermore, a mandatory routing condition stipulates that precisely one of the following two connections must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the link between Office Beta and Office Gamma, or the link between Office Gamma and Office Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed-loop itinerary that inspects each office precisely once before returning to the point of origin.
